read correlated M365/Entra/Sophos summaries through QAPAQ adapters
normalize URL as text without visiting it

submit notification intent through QAPAQ outbox
playbooks.failure: mark partial/degraded and retain retryable reference; never treat missing provider response as clean

steps: validate signed dispatch and identity scope
deduplicate executionKey
read Entra sign-in and AD event summaries via QAPAQ
read Cato site/session context via QAPAQ
build UTC timeline with source confidence and missing-data flags
attach analyst questions and evidence references
playbooks.failure: mark source-specific gaps; do not infer benign status from an unavailable feed

steps: validate endpoint and tenant references
deduplicate executionKey
read Sophos detection and remedy status
read matching Cato threat events and marker provenance
read Wazuh process/FIM context if available
summarize hash, destination, action and confidence without uploading samples
notify through QAPAQ outbox
playbooks.failure: preserve evidence refs and mark partial; do not re-run cleanup or containment

read role/group change and approved change metadata

show owner, time, change request and evidence lineage
route to human analyst and QAPAQ approval queue if response requested
playbooks.failure: flag unknown change approval and escalate to analyst; no automatic role revert

steps: validate source and tenant scope
deduplicate executionKey
read bounded Entra/AD failure and success summaries
enrich source network with Cato only if available
count distinct identities and successful follow-on logins
attach threshold, window and evidence to incident
playbooks.failure: mark Cato context unavailable and continue with identity evidence; do not block source IP

steps: validate signed dispatch and case access
deduplicate executionKey
read M365 share/download/export summaries
read Cato destination/volume summary
compare against approved role/site baseline
attach sensitivity and provenance; request human review
playbooks.failure: do not label exfiltration without correlated evidence and baseline

globalGuards: all playbooks are read-only until separately approved action workflows are implemented
no API keys, OAuth tokens, passwords, raw mailbox body or attachments in Shuffle variables or exports
all events are untrusted input; validate schema, signature, timestamp, nonce, replay window, tenant and references
stable executionKey and durable QAPAQ audit/outbox; retries must be idempotent
source failure or missing telemetry yields degraded/unknown, never healthy or clean
no URL browsing, file upload, endpoint isolation, IOC block, session revocation, account disablement or policy mutation
